ruleset.name: Exalted Versus World of Darkness
ruleset.edition: Exalted vs World of Darkness (Revised), a fan crossover running Exalted-style Chosen on the World of Darkness 20th-anniversary Storyteller chassis.

Exalted and its Charm/Caste names belong to Onyx Path Publishing; World of Darkness clan/Discipline/sect names belong to Paradox Interactive AB. ruleset.summary: Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 baseline. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die at or above the chosen difficulty (default 6, range 6-9, capped at 9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success EXCEPT on a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, where 1s do not subtract. Botch only on zero successes AND at least one 1. 10s count as one success unless a Charm says otherwise. Power runs on a single fungible Essence/mote pool spent on Charms; no blood, no Humanity, no Frenzy. Intimacies anchor the character and resist supernatural compulsion (Willpower vs 8).

resolution.poolFormula: Attribute + Ability (+ specialty +1, + Charm dice). On a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, 1s do not subtract successes.

Trivial.description: Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.

Standard.description: ExvWoD / V20 default. Average task under normal conditions.

Challenging.description: Pushes a competent character; pressure or distraction.

Difficult.description: Few mortals succeed without supernatural aid.

Nigh-Impossible.description: Heroic. Difficulty never exceeds 9 in ExvWoD, regardless of modifiers.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools.

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.description: Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging.

attributes.name: Stamina
attributes.description: Endurance, soak (Exalts soak all damage types), resisting fatigue.

attributes.name: Charisma
attributes.description: Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.

attributes.name: Manipulation
attributes.description: Deceit, guile, indirect influence, getting others to act against their interest.

attributes.name: Appearance
attributes.description: Beauty / presence; affects attraction, allure, first-impression rolls.

attributes.name: Perception

attributes.name: Wits
attributes.description: Reaction speed, on-the-fly thinking, initiative component.

skills.name: Subterfuge

skills.name: Animal Ken

skills.name: Drive

derivedStats.name: Motes
derivedStats.formula: The single fungible Essence pool (called the Essence Pool in the rules; named Motes here so it is not confused with the Essence rating). Charms and committed artifacts spend from this one pool. Its maximum is set by the 'Mote Pool' stat.

derivedStats.name: Permanent Willpower
derivedStats.formula: The character's permanent Willpower rating, 1-10 (all Exalted begin at 5). This is the CAP on the Willpower pool shown in the Resources cluster. Adjust this stepper directly — raise it as the character spends XP. Temporary Willpower refreshes to this rating on a full rest; regain 1 (once per session) for strongly affirming an Intimacy.

derivedStats.name: Mote Pool
derivedStats.formula: The maximum size of the Motes (Essence) pool. It depends on BOTH Exalt type and Essence rating, so there is no single formula — set this stepper from the table in the 'Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type)' lorebook entry. Solars/Abyssals/Infernals: E1=10, E2=12, E3=15, E4=17, E5=20. Lunars/Sidereals/Alchemicals: E1=8, E2=10, E3=12, E4=14, E5=15. Dragon-Blooded: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10. Liminals: E1=6, E2=8, E3=10, E4=11, E5=12. Raise it when your Essence rating goes up. The Motes bar in the Resources cluster uses this as its cap.

derivedStats.name: Health Track
derivedStats.formula: 7 levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0) / Hurt(-1) / Injured(-1) / Wounded(-2) / Maimed(-2) / Crippled(-5) / Incapacitated. Penalty in effect = the highest filled box. Bashing/Lethal/Aggravated tracked separately. Charms (Ox-Body Technique, Flesh-aspect levels, Mutations) ADD levels at runtime via the track's 'Add level' buttons.

damageTypes.label: B
damageTypes.description: Blunt or non-lethal. Exalts soak with Stamina + armour at difficulty 6. Heals in ~30 minutes per level.

damageTypes.label: L
damageTypes.description: Edged, piercing, gunfire. Exalts soak with Stamina + armour at difficulty 6 (mortals need armour). Heals in ~30 minutes per level (1 hour for Maimed/Crippled).

damageTypes.label: A
damageTypes.description: Fire, sunlight (to vulnerable types), supernatural claws, divine effects. Exalts may still soak it (Stamina + armour, difficulty 6). Heals slowest; Incapacitated aggravated takes ~12 hours.

derivedStats.name: Join Battle
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Wits + 1d10 each combat. Act highest to lowest; ties to highest Dexterity + Wits. Wound penalty subtracts from the rating, not the d10.

derivedStats.name: Melee Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Melee. Armed close-combat attack pool (blades, clubs, daiklaves). Charms and weapons modify it.

derivedStats.name: Ranged Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Firearms. Ranged attack pool (range modifiers add difficulty: +1 medium, +2 long). Charms and weapons modify it.

derivedStats.name: Unarmed Attack
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Brawl. Unarmed attack pool (punches, grapples, claw strikes). Charms modify it.

derivedStats.name: Soak
derivedStats.formula: Stamina + armour soak dice, rolled at difficulty 6. Exalts soak ALL THREE damage types (bashing, lethal, AND aggravated) with the same Stamina + armour pool — unlike most WoD creatures, who cannot soak lethal/aggravated without armour. Optional rule: if the Storyteller uses Dangerous Aggravated, aggravated soak is difficulty 8 instead of 6. Soak rolls cannot botch.

derivedStats.name: Parry
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Melee (or Dexterity + Brawl unarmed). Defence pool versus close attacks. Charms and weapons modify it.

derivedStats.name: Evade
derivedStats.formula: Dexterity + Athletics. Defence pool to avoid an attack entirely. ExvWoD has no Dodge Ability — Athletics covers evasion.

derivedStats.name: Limit / Alienation
derivedStats.formula: 0-10. Liminals track Alienation here (gained from botches, betraying Nature/Intimacy, horror reactions, harming the lifeline; at 10 = Alienation state). Other Exalt types with a Great-Curse-style Flaw (Solar Intemperate, Lunar Bestial Fury, Dragon-Blooded Driven by the Elements, Infernal Thrall of the Wyrm, Sidereal Brittle Reality) track their Limit here. Most characters leave this at 0.

values.label: Dormant
values.description: No outward flare. The spiritual aura is invisible; the Caste mark is dormant. Use when the Exalt has spent fewer than 3 Essence this scene, or is a non-Exalt.

values.label: Glimmering
values.description: 1-2 Essence spent this scene. Faint shimmer; the Caste mark glints when Essence is spent but the banner is not yet alight.

values.label: Bonfire
values.trigger: 3+ points of Essence spent in a single scene.
values.description: Anima banner becomes visible — in the depleted World of Darkness it rises only a few feet, bright as a burning bonfire, in the colour/texture of the Exalt's brand. The Caste mark involuntarily blazes on the forehead (Dragon-Blooded show Aspect markings / elemental flux instead; Fire Aspects deal 2 lethal/turn to adjacent beings, others 1 lethal/turn). Fades (Essence rating x 3) minutes after the Exalt stops spending Essence.

values.label: Iconic
values.description: Sustained bonfire or specific Charm triggers. The banner takes on the Exalt's full totemic / divine spirit-shape. Unmistakable; everyone present knows a great power walks among them.

values.label: Ancient Sorcerer
values.description: Has the Hedge Magic / Ancient Sorcery training (Occult 3+, plus a mentor, grimoire, or Brigid's Heir). Spells are cast as extended Wits + Occult rolls (difficulty 7-9) with an Essence cost and ritual time.

resources.label: Motes (Essence pool; cap = Mote Pool stat)

lorebook.name: Exalted vs World of Darkness Reference
lorebook.description: Keyword-triggered reference for Exalted Versus World of Darkness (Revised): modified V20 dice mechanics, Essence/mote economy, Charms, anima, Intimacies, and per-Exalt-type overviews. Original mechanics references only; Exalted and World of Darkness names belong to Onyx Path Publishing and Paradox Interactive AB. Unofficial fan material.

entries.name: Rule: Dice-pool resolution
entries.content: ExvWoD uses a modified V20 Storyteller system. Roll a pool of d10s equal to (Attribute + Ability), plus specialty (+1 die in scope) and any Charm dice. Each die at or above the chosen difficulty is one success; default difficulty is 6 (range 6-9). At least one net success means the action works. A 10 counts as ONE success unless a Charm or anima power explicitly doubles it. Difficulty never exceeds 9 — if modifiers would push it to 10 it stays at 9. Flashy/dramatic descriptions never raise the difficulty for Exalts (see the Stunts entry) but grant no bonus dice.

entries.name: Rule: The Rule of One & Caste Abilities
entries.content: Each 1 rolled normally subtracts one success from the total. EXCEPTION: when the roll uses a Caste Ability (Solars, Abyssals, Sidereals), an Aspect Ability (Dragon-Blooded), or a Key Ability (Infernals) — or, for Lunars/Alchemicals/Liminals, the relevant Caste/Aspect Attribute — 1s do NOT subtract successes. They can still contribute to a botch only if the roll has zero successes overall. This is the signature ExvWoD reliability of an Exalt acting within her sphere of mastery.

entries.name: Rule: Botch
entries.content: A botch occurs ONLY when a roll produces zero successes AND shows at least one 1. A roll that fails merely because 1s cancelled all its successes is a plain failure, not a botch, no matter how many 1s appeared. On a botch the Storyteller introduces a real complication, not just a miss.

entries.name: Rule: Difficulty ladder
entries.content: Difficulty 4 = trivial (often waived). 5 = routine. 6 = standard (the default). 7 = challenging. 8 = difficult (few mortals without aid). 9 = nigh-impossible. Difficulty is capped at 9 in ExvWoD regardless of penalties; excess modifiers instead become extra successes required or are narrated as raised stakes.

entries.name: Rule: Specialties
entries.content: A specialty is a narrow focus within an Attribute or Ability (e.g. Melee: Daiklave, Occult: Spirits). When the action falls within the specialty, add +1 die to the pool. ExvWoD does not use the oWoD 10-again specialty reroll; the bonus is a flat extra die.

entries.name: Rule: Willpower
entries.content: Willpower is rated 1-10; all Exalted begin play at 5. Spend 1 to resist mental/emotional compulsion, to power some Charms, or — crucially — to REFUSE to act against an Intimacy (Willpower vs difficulty 8; see Intimacies). Willpower also substitutes for any WoD trait an Exalt lacks (Rage, Self-Control, Gnosis, etc.) when a crossover power demands it. Temporary Willpower refreshes to the permanent rating after a full rest; regain 1 once per session for strongly affirming an Intimacy.

entries.name: Rule: Health track & Exalted healing
entries.content: Seven levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0), Hurt(-1), Injured(-1), Wounded(-2), Maimed(-2), Crippled(-5), Incapacitated. The penalty of the highest filled box applies to all dice pools. Damage is Bashing, Lethal, or Aggravated, tracked separately. Exalts heal fast — roughly 30 minutes per level (1 hour for Maimed/Crippled, 12 hours for Incapacitated aggravated) — and never scar or cripple permanently short of full amputation. Charms such as Ox-Body Technique, Lunar/Liminal Flesh-aspect levels, and Mutations permanently ADD health levels; the player adds these on the Health Track widget via its 'Add level' buttons (-0/-1/-2 and 'remove last'), not as a damage delta.

entries.name: Rule: Soak & Damage Types
entries.content: Unlike most WoD creatures, Exalted soak BASHING, LETHAL, and AGGRAVATED with Stamina + armour dice at difficulty 6 (each soak success cancels one damage die; soak rolls cannot botch). Mortals cannot soak lethal or aggravated without armour, and never soak with Stamina against those. Optional 'Dangerous Aggravated' rule: aggravated soak is difficulty 8. Exalts may parry ranged attacks (even bullets) if capable. Cold iron and silver do not bypass Exalt defences; fire/sunlight only deal aggravated to types with a specific vulnerability (e.g. the Sun-Seared Flaw).

entries.name: Rule: Combat round
entries.content: Initiative = Dexterity + Wits + 1d10; act highest to lowest, ties to highest Dex+Wits. Wound penalty subtracts from the rating, not the d10. No advance declaration, no abort rules, no multiple-opponent penalty. Multiple actions: declare the total; first action -1 die/+1 difficulty, each further action -1/+1 more; at most ONE attack per multiple-action set; stop if difficulty would exceed 9. Extra actions (Celerity-equivalent Charms, etc.) use the full pool, may include several attacks, and resolve at end of turn in initiative order. Attack pools: Brawl=Dex+Brawl, Melee=Dex+Melee, ranged=Dex+Firearms, thrown=Dex+Athletics.

entries.name: Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type)
entries.content: ExvWoD uses ONE fungible mote pool (the Essence Pool; called Motes on the sheet so it is not confused with the Essence rating). Personal and Peripheral are not separated. Set the 'Mote Pool' stat in DERIVED POOLS to the value for your Exalt type and Essence rating (the Motes bar uses it as its cap). Solars/Abyssals/Infernals: E1=10, E2=12, E3=15, E4=17, E5=20 (spend/turn 1/2/3/4/5). Lunars/Sidereals/Alchemicals: E1=8, E2=10, E3=12, E4=14, E5=15 (spend/turn 1/2/3/3/4). Dragon-Blooded: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10 (spend/turn 1/1/2/2/3). Liminals: E1=6, E2=8, E3=10, E4=11, E5=12 (spend/turn 1/2/2/3/3). Essence rating is capped at 5; per-turn spend is limited by the table — Charms costing more than that take several turns to channel.

entries.name: Rule: Regaining Essence
entries.content: Sunrise/Sunset grant: Solars, Infernals, Alchemicals, Dragon-Blooded gain (3 + Essence rating) motes at sunrise; Abyssals, Lunars, Sidereals, Liminals gain the same at sunset (no need to see it). Starting a scene at 0 motes grants 1. Dragon Nests restore 1 mote per 15 minutes. Each Caste/Aspect (and Infernal Urge) has a once-per-scene condition granting 2 motes. Spirit World: 1/3 hours (not Liminals). The Dreaming: 1/6 hours (all). The Underworld: 1/3 hours (Abyssals & Liminals). Dragon-Blooded may meditate 1 hour/day in an Aspect-appropriate place for 2 motes.

entries.name: Rule: Anima Banner & Caste Marks
entries.content: Spending 3 or more motes in a single scene makes the anima banner visible. In the depleted World of Darkness it rises only a few feet, bright as a bonfire, in the Exalt's characteristic colour, and the Caste mark involuntarily blazes on the forehead. It fades (Essence rating x 3) minutes after she stops actively spending. The banner is an unmistakable tell that a great supernatural power is present (though only the wisest spirits recognise WHAT). Dragon-Blooded have no Caste mark — they manifest Aspect markings and destructive elemental anima flux: when flaring, everything within ~1 yard takes 1 lethal/turn (2 for Fire Aspects). The Anima Control Merit grants control over flaring.

entries.name: Rule: Intimacies
entries.content: Every Exalt has about three Intimacies: either a personal tie stated with its emotion ('My sister (love)', 'Prince Vitel (hatred)') or a statement of philosophy ('Power demands restraint'). When something tries to force the character to act against, abandon, or betray an Intimacy, the player may roll Willpower vs difficulty 8 to refuse — even as a SECOND line of defence after already failing to resist a compulsion power such as Dominate. Strongly affirming an Intimacy through action restores 1 Willpower, once per session. Intimacies replace WoD Humanity/Virtues; ExvWoD has no Frenzy and no blood/Hunger.

entries.name: Rule: Stunts (flashy action)
entries.content: ExvWoD's stunt rule is simple and is NOT a dice-bonus tier system (that is Exalted 3e, not ExvWoD). For an Exalt, doing something in a dramatic, stylish, or extravagant way carries NO mechanical penalty and does NOT raise the difficulty: 'kick a guy' and 'swing around a lamppost and kick a guy in the face with both feet' have the exact same difficulty. It grants no bonus dice — the reward is in the story, not the pool. The rule applies only to Exalted; mortals, vampires, werewolves, etc. remain subject to the standard Storyteller difficulty modifiers for ambitious actions. It applies to the action's difficulty, not its outcome — spectacle never makes success harder, but it does not guarantee success either.

entries.name: Rule: Ancient Sorcery
entries.content: Ancient Sorcery is the lost spellcraft of the Age of Legends. It requires Occult 3+ and a source (a mentor who knows the spell, a grimoire, or the Brigid's Heir Merit once per story). Learning a spell costs 10 XP (5 freebie points at creation). Casting is usually an extended Wits + Occult roll at difficulty 7-9 with an Essence cost and ritual time, sometimes components, a location, or sacrifice. Alchemicals and Liminals generally cannot learn it; Dragon Kings only at Essence 5.

entries.name: Rule: Backgrounds
entries.content: Characters start with 5 dots of Backgrounds (1 freebie/dot at creation; current rating x2 XP to raise in play). Standard WoD Backgrounds apply (Allies, Contacts, Resources, Influence, Fame, Mentor, Retainers, etc.). ExvWoD-specific: Dragon Nest (a secure Essence-rich haven; dots = infiltration difficulty), Past Lives (once/session add the rating to an appropriate ancient Ability roll — Solars/Lunars/Abyssals/Infernals/Dragon Kings), Supernatural Status (standing in a WoD faction, Acknowledged through Revered). Type-specific Backgrounds include Heart's Blood (Lunar forms), Arcane (Sidereal), Whispers/Spectre Notoriety (Abyssal), Demonic Guide (Infernal), Primium Countermeasures (Alchemical), Dragon-Touched/Jade Talisman (Dragon-Blooded).

entries.name: Rule: Merits & Flaws
entries.content: Up to 7 points each of Merits and Flaws, bought with freebie points at creation, and you cannot take ones aimed at other supernatural types. Notable Exalted Merits: Anima Control (1/2/5pt, control banner flaring), Priest, Brigid's Heir, Hedge Magic, Exalted Kinfolk/Kinain, Perfection of the Grave (Abyssal), Drifting Moon Aptitude (Lunar). Notable Flaws: Beacon of Power (flare at 2 motes/scene), Sun-Seared (sunlight burns — Abyssal/Infernal/Liminal), Permanent Caste Mark, Casteless (Lunar), Aspect of the Corpse (Abyssal), plus per-type Great-Curse Flaws (Solar Intemperate, Lunar Bestial Fury, Dragon-Blooded Driven by the Elements, Infernal Thrall of the Wyrm, Sidereal Brittle Reality) tracked on the Limit/Alienation stat.

entries.name: Rule: Cross-Game Reconciliation
entries.content: The WoD games were not built for crossover. Substitute Willpower for any trait an Exalt lacks (Rage, Self-Control, Gnosis, Spite). For powers calibrated by power level, Exalts always fall in the 'supernatural target' (not 'mortal') category. Absolute effect vs absolute defence: the defence wins; two absolutes with no clear defence = contested Willpower. Power equivalence (Celestial Exalted): Essence 1/2/3/4/5 ~ Vampire Generation 8/7/6/5/4, Werewolf Rank 2/3/4/5/6, Mage Arete 2/4/6/8/10 (Terrestrial/Liminal: Generation 11/10/9/8/7). An Exalt sharing Essence with others converts: 1 Essence = 2 Quintessence/Glamour/Conviction, 3 Faith/Chi/Sekhem, 1 Pathos; it cannot become vampire Blood, werewolf Rage, or Gnosis.

entries.name: Adding Charms to your sheet
entries.content: ExvWoD ships no Charm catalogue (there are hundreds across nine Exalt types); you add the Charms you intend to use yourself. Open the CHARMS flyout. It has generic buckets — Caste / Aspect Charms, Favoured / Key Charms, Other Charms, Shapeshifting (Lunar), Anima / Caste Power, Ancient Sorcery — plus a '+ Add Charms' button to create your own bucket (e.g. one per Ability like 'Melee', or per Caste, if you prefer the book's organisation). Each bucket header has a small 0-10 number box: that is a generic per-line rating the framework attaches in dice-pool systems (it is the Discipline rating in Vampire); ExvWoD Charms are individual powers and are NOT rated as a line, so you can leave it at 0 or use it as a personal Charm-count/favoured marker — it does not affect dice. Inside a bucket click '+ Add': give the Charm a Name, optional rating dots, and put its activation cost in the cost field using the syntax the Cast button parses — motes as "5m" or "5 mote", Willpower as "1wp" or "1 willpower" (combine: "5m, 1wp"). Reflexive / Scene-long / Once-per-story / keyword notes go in the notes field. Clicking Cast deducts the cost from the single Motes pool (and Willpower) and injects a cast tag. For a Charm or artifact that COMMITS motes for a duration, add it instead as an Inventory item with mote_commitment=N and mote_pool="Personal"; equipping it locks those motes out of the Motes bar automatically and unequipping returns them. Copy real Charm text (cost, mins, type, keywords, duration, effect) from the relevant Exalted vs WoD Charm list into the notes so the narrator adjudicates it correctly. Health-level Charms (Ox-Body Technique, Flesh-aspect levels, Mutations): add the granted levels with the Health Track widget's 'Add level' buttons (-0/-1/-2). The buttons only emit -0/-1/-2; for a rarer Crippled (-5) grant, add a -2 cell and note the true -5 penalty in the character notes (or have the Storyteller apply it).

entries.name: Optional Sub-Agents — what they do and how to enable
entries.content: Besides the main Ruleset Helper, the bundle ships five focused pre-generation sub-agents, all DISABLED by default. Enable any of them in Marinara -> Settings -> Agents (each enabled agent costs one extra model call per turn). state-reminder: a terse current-state HUD each turn (motes, Willpower, health, anima, Intimacies). state-mutator: tells the narrator when to emit [mrrp-state: ...] sheet-change tags. combat-adjudicator: wakes only in combat; enforces initiative, pools, soak, Charm costs. lore-query: answers explicit out-of-character rules questions from the lorebook. npc-bookkeeper: tracks active/recent NPCs (pools, health, anima, attitude) for continuity. Enable state-reminder + state-mutator first if you want the floating sheet to stay in sync; add the others for crunchier play.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Solar
entries.content: Solars — the returned legends of sun, law, and heroic perfection. Castes: Dawn (war), Zenith (priest/leader), Twilight (savant/sorcerer), Night (spy/assassin), Eclipse (diplomat/oath-binder). Celestial Essence pool (E1=10 ... E5=20). Caste Abilities (8 per Caste) get the 1s-don't-subtract benefit. Each Caste has its own anima power and a once/scene Essence-renewal trigger. May select Supernal Charms at Essence 2+ (first from Caste, second from any). Caste mark blazes when the anima flares. Charms organised by Ability. Power equivalence ~ Vampire Generation 8 down to 4 across Essence 1-5.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Lunar
entries.content: Lunars — wild shapeshifters of survival and freedom. Castes: Full Moon (warrior), Changing Moon (trickster/social), No Moon (shaman/sorcerer). They key off Caste ATTRIBUTES (Full=Physical, Changing=Social, No=Mental) for the 1s-don't-subtract benefit, not Caste Abilities. Lunar/Sidereal/Alchemical Essence pool (E1=8 ... E5=15). Shapeshifting: gain forms by hunting/killing an animal or from a spirit; totem form free, rage form for combat (Heart's Blood Background = extra forms). Silver Marks of Luna protect against unwilling transformation. Mandatory fourth Intimacy: 'I will never wear chains.' Regain Essence at sunset.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Dragon-Blooded
entries.content: Dragon-Blooded — the Terrestrial Exalted, the most numerous and the only ones native to the World of Darkness. Aspects: Air, Earth, Fire, Water, Wood (elemental, not Castes). Aspect Abilities (8 per Aspect) get the 1s-don't-subtract benefit. Smallest pools of all: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10. No Caste mark; instead Aspect markings and destructive anima FLUX — when flaring, all within ~1 yard take 1 lethal/turn (Fire: 2). Aspect affinity reduces the cost of native-Aspect Charms by 1 once/scene. Regain Essence at sunrise or via a 1-hour daily Aspect-appropriate meditation (2 motes).

entries.name: Exalt Type: Sidereal
entries.content: Sidereals — hidden fate-weavers. Castes: Chosen of Journeys, Serenity, Battles, Secrets, Endings. Caste Abilities (8 per Caste) get the 1s benefit. Lunar/Sidereal/Alchemical pool (E1=8 ... E5=15); regain Essence at sunset. Lesser Sign anima powers (scene-long benefit). Dynamic LARPing: spend 1 Willpower to wear a false destiny and pass as a mortal archetype (only other Sidereals see through). Greater Signs at Essence 4+ cost permanent Willpower for catastrophic effects. Arcane Background (2 free dots; +2 Stealth, harder to track; caps Fame). Cannot take Destiny Background or Dark Fate.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Abyssal
entries.content: Abyssals — Chosen of death and the Neverborn, dark mirrors of Solars. Castes: Dusk, Midnight, Daybreak, Day, Moonshadow. Caste Abilities (8 per Caste) get the 1s benefit. Solar-tier pool (E1=10 ... E5=20) but regain Essence at SUNSET and gain less from many triggers. Power in the Blood: manifest fangs, drink blood for Essence. Shadows of Death: pick 2 cosmetic death-omens; the local Shroud drops by Essence rating. Trappings of the Grave: without death symbolism, +1 difficulty to all actions among the living. The Nameless Curse forbids speaking the true name, increasing the living population, or saving living lives. Apocalyptic Charms at Essence 2+/4+.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Infernal
entries.content: Infernals — demon-princes of Hell. No Castes; instead 7 Crowns (Eyes, Flames, Glory, Kings, Night, Worlds, Wrath) that set the anima power. Solar-tier pool (E1=10 ... E5=20); regain Essence at sunrise and by satisfying an Urge once/scene (2 motes). Choose 8 Key Abilities (function as Caste Abilities — 1s don't subtract) and 2 Key Charm categories (XP discount). Shintai (demon form) unlocks at Essence 2+ (2 motes + 2 Willpower the first time, then escalating Essence rolls); it replaces the health track with its own and grants Demonic Aspects. Charm categories: General, Kakuri, Lanka, Skinned Alive, Wicked City, Hells.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Alchemical
entries.content: Alchemicals — living machine-Exalted built by a Sublime Artificer, not born (appendix type). Castes: Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel, each with 3 Caste Attributes (1s don't subtract on those). Lunar-tier pool (E1=8 ... E5=15); regain Essence at sunrise and by expressing Caste nature once/scene. No anima banner flare — instead a Caste Attribute bonus while powered. Charms live in a reconfigurable Charm Array (7 slots at E1, +2 per Essence); reconfigure during Dormancy (Willpower roll, 6 hours). All Charms cost the favoured rate. Primium Countermeasures Background grants innate countermagick vs mages. Cannot learn Ancient Sorcery.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Liminal
entries.content: Liminals — living corpses reassembled by a mortal's intense passion (appendix type). Aspects: Blood, Breath, Flesh, Marrow, Soil. Choose 3 Aspect Attributes (1s don't subtract; Charms matching them are favoured). Smallest-but-one pool: E1=6, E2=8, E3=10, E4=11, E5=12; regain Essence at sunset. Aspect markings manifest voluntarily or on anima flare (Appearance 0 socially; witnesses roll Willpower vs 8 or recoil). Alienation track (0-10, on the Limit/Alienation stat): rises from botches, betrayals, witnessed horror, harming the lifeline; at 10 = Alienation state. The Lifeline is a mandatory Intimacy bond to the creator — without it a Liminal cannot regain Willpower from sleep. Undying: resurrect on an Essence roll unless the brain is destroyed. Mandatory fourth Intimacy: 'I will drive the Unquiet away from the living.' Cannot take the Totem Background.

entries.name: Exalt Type: Dragon Kings
entries.content: Dragon Kings — ancient reptilian sapients of the Hollow Earth; NOT Exalted (no Charms, no anima, no Caste mark). Breeds: Raptok, Anklok, Pterok, Mosok. Dragon-Blooded-tier pool (E1=5 ... E5=10); respire (2 + Essence) motes at sunrise. Instead of Charms they buy Paths of Prehuman Mastery (10 paths, rated 1-5, purchased in ascending order like Disciplines). Essence rating caps both maximum Intelligence and maximum Path rating; PCs start at Essence 2. Breed Attributes/Abilities (3 each) are immune to 1s. Cannot soak aggravated or parry ranged attacks without Path abilities. Ancient Sorcery only at Essence 5.

entries.name: Derived stat: Motes
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Motes — formula: The single fungible Essence pool (called the Essence Pool in the rules; named Motes here so it is not confused with the Essence rating). Charms and committed artifacts spend from this one pool. Its maximum is set by the 'Mote Pool' stat.

entries.name: Derived stat: Permanent Willpower
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Permanent Willpower — formula: The character's permanent Willpower rating, 1-10 (all Exalted begin at 5). This is the CAP on the Willpower pool shown in the Resources cluster. Adjust this stepper directly — raise it as the character spends XP. Temporary Willpower refreshes to this rating on a full rest; regain 1 (once per session) for strongly affirming an Intimacy.

entries.name: Derived stat: Mote Pool
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Mote Pool — formula: The maximum size of the Motes (Essence) pool. It depends on BOTH Exalt type and Essence rating, so there is no single formula — set this stepper from the table in the 'Rule: Essence Pools (per Exalt type)' lorebook entry. Solars/Abyssals/Infernals: E1=10, E2=12, E3=15, E4=17, E5=20. Lunars/Sidereals/Alchemicals: E1=8, E2=10, E3=12, E4=14, E5=15. Dragon-Blooded: E1=5, E2=6, E3=7, E4=8, E5=10. Liminals: E1=6, E2=8, E3=10, E4=11, E5=12. Raise it when your Essence rating goes up. The Motes bar in the Resources cluster uses this as its cap.

entries.name: Derived stat: Health Track
entries.content: Exalted Versus World of Darkness derived stat. Health Track — formula: 7 levels (V20 baseline): Bruised(-0) / Hurt(-1) / Injured(-1) / Wounded(-2) / Maimed(-2) / Crippled(-5) / Incapacitated. Penalty in effect = the highest filled box. Bashing/Lethal/Aggravated tracked separately. Charms (Ox-Body Technique, Flesh-aspect levels, Mutations) ADD levels at runtime via the track's 'Add level' buttons.

entries.name: Difficulty ladder reference
entries.content:
Exalted Versus World of Darkness difficulty ladder. Threshold values needed for success:
- Trivial (threshold 4) — Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.
- Routine (threshold 5) — Routine task; minor pressure.
- Standard (threshold 6) — ExvWoD / V20 default. Average task under normal conditions.
- Challenging (threshold 7) — Pushes a competent character; pressure or distraction.
- Difficult (threshold 8) — Few mortals succeed without supernatural aid.
- Nigh-Impossible (threshold 9) — Heroic. Difficulty never exceeds 9 in ExvWoD, regardless of modifiers.

# Exalted Versus World of Darkness — canonical reference

Storyteller-system d10 dice pool on the V20 baseline. Pool = Attribute + Ability. Each die at or above the chosen difficulty (default 6, range 6-9, capped at 9) is one success. A 1 subtracts one success EXCEPT on a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, where 1s do not subtract. Botch only on zero successes AND at least one 1. 10s count as one success unless a Charm says otherwise. Power runs on a single fungible Essence/mote pool spent on Charms; no blood, no Humanity, no Frenzy. Intimacies anchor the character and resist supernatural compulsion (Willpower vs 8).

## Dice
- Type: `d10`
- Notation: `Xd10 vs <difficulty>`

## Resolution
- Mode: `dice-pool`
- Pool formula: Attribute + Ability (+ specialty +1, + Charm dice). On a Caste/Aspect/Key Ability, 1s do not subtract successes.
- Default target: 6

## Difficulty ladder
- **Trivial** (threshold 4) — Trivial for a competent character. Often waived.
- **Routine** (threshold 5) — Routine task; minor pressure.
- **Standard** (threshold 6) — ExvWoD / V20 default. Average task under normal conditions.
- **Challenging** (threshold 7) — Pushes a competent character; pressure or distraction.
- **Difficult** (threshold 8) — Few mortals succeed without supernatural aid.
- **Nigh-Impossible** (threshold 9) — Heroic. Difficulty never exceeds 9 in ExvWoD, regardless of modifiers.

## Attributes
- **Strength** (STR) [Physical] — Raw muscle. Lifting, melee damage, brawling pools.
- **Dexterity** (DEX) [Physical] — Agility, hand-eye coordination, attack accuracy, dodging.
- **Stamina** (STA) [Physical] — Endurance, soak (Exalts soak all damage types), resisting fatigue.
- **Charisma** (CHA) [Social] — Force of personality, sincere charm, leadership presence.
- **Manipulation** (MAN) [Social] — Deceit, guile, indirect influence, getting others to act against their interest.

- **Perception** (PER) [Mental] — Spotting, hearing, noticing details and changes in environment.

## Skills
